name: Containers & Virtualization
shortDesc: Docker / Podman container engines and interactive management dashboards.
detailedDesc: Run development databases, local web servers, and isolated environments.

phase.title: Developer Toolchains & CLI Ergonomics
phase.description: Modern Rust/Go coreutils replacements, Git interfaces, Docker container managers, and polyglot runtime toolchains.

packages.name: Docker + Docker Compose (Recommended Engine)
packages.description: Industry-standard containerization platform with multi-container Docker Compose orchestration.

packages.name: lazydocker (Recommended TUI)
packages.description: Interactive terminal UI for Docker containers, images, volumes, and live streaming logs.
pros: View real-time CPU/RAM usage per container
Stream logs and attach shells in 1 keystroke

packages.name: Podman + Podman Desktop
packages.description: Daemonless, rootless container engine with full Docker command line compatibility.
pros: No background daemon running when idle
cons: Occasional differences in Docker socket binding for third-party dev tools

packages.name: oxker (Rust Docker TUI)
packages.description: Ultra-fast, lightweight TUI for monitoring Docker containers written in Rust.
cons: Fewer container control options than lazydocker
